features.name: main.py — launcher
features.detail: UTF-8 reconfigures stdout. Starts the FastAPI API (uvicorn) on 127.0.0.1:8500 in a daemon thread, then the Gradio UI on 7840 in the main thread. Logs to data/logs/mq.log. Booted manually once (2026-06-10) per mq.log; no persistent NSSM service registered.

features.name: Start_MQ.bat
features.detail: Convenience launcher: cd /d C:\MQ then python main.py. Prints API :8500 / UI :7840. The only supported way to run MQ today (manual, foreground).

features.name: Config loader
features.detail: Loads secrets/mq.env (python-dotenv) then config/mq.json into a module-level cache. get('dotted.path', default) accessor. Single source of runtime config for every agent.

features.name: Runtime config
features.detail: app/server/persona/content_streams/llm/kaze/fumi sections. Ports 8500/7840, LLM primary=@cf/qwen/qwen2.5-7b-instruct-fast with ollama qwen3:8b fallback, RSS source lists, posts/digests dir layout.

features.name: QI Module Interface Contract
features.detail: GET /health -> {status:ok}; GET /version -> {project:mq, version:0.1.0, status:development}; GET /info -> QI.project('mq') from the registry, with a static fallback. CORS origins from qi_registry (fallback to localhost). No business endpoints yet — '# Add your endpoints below this line'.

features.name: Gradio UI shell
features.detail: Minimal 2-tab Blocks app (Status, About). Status tab pings the API /health and reports Online/Offline/Error. Placeholder — no persona, content, or admin controls yet.

features.name: RSS digest scraper
features.detail: Per-stream (travel/photo/ai/all). feedparser parses each source's RSS, strips HTML from summaries (capped 500 chars), dedupes by md5(url)[:12], sorts newest-first, writes data/digests/kaze-<stream>-digest.json. Complete and runnable; never executed (no digests on disk).

features.name: Stable item id
features.detail: hashlib.md5(url).hexdigest()[:12] — gives each fetched item a deterministic id used for in-run dedup and later draft naming.

features.name: Post generator
features.detail: Reads a Kaze digest, picks top N items, builds a persona+instruction+context prompt, calls the LLM, writes a draft JSON to data/posts/drafts/. Per-stream instructions (travel/photo/ai) and per-page persona. Never run.

features.name: Persona prompts
features.detail: Two inline system prompts: Maia (warm/curious/witty, first person, 80-150 words, 1-2 emojis, occasional Portuguese) and QI (thought-leader, 100-180 words). To migrate into maia/voice per the architecture (D11).

features.name: LLM client + failover
features.detail: Tries Cloudflare Workers AI (urllib POST to /accounts/{id}/ai/run/{model}, needs CF_ACCOUNT_ID + CF_AI_TOKEN), falls back to local Ollama (/api/generate). Raises if both fail. No keys configured.

features.name: Facebook Graph publisher
features.detail: POSTs message (+ optional link) to graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{page_id}/feed. On success records fb_post_id + published_at and moves the draft to published/; on HTTPError/exception records the error and moves to failed/. Blocked — no page token.

features.name: Page token resolver
features.detail: page='maia' -> FB_PAGE_ID/FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN; page='qi' -> QI_PAGE_ID/QI_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN, from secrets/mq.env. Raises a clear error when credentials are missing (current state).

features.name: Draft lifecycle / CLI
features.detail: drafts/ -> published/ or failed/ file moves. CLI: --list, --draft <id>, --all-drafts, --dry-run (preview, no API call). Dry-run is the only path exercisable without credentials.

features.name: Pipeline orchestrator
features.detail: Two named pipelines: maia_weekly (Kaze travel+photo -> Fumi generate -> publish) and qi_daily (Kaze ai -> Fumi generate -> publish). Runs each step via subprocess, continues on failure, injects --dry-run for the publish step. Designed for Task Scheduler.

features.name: Task Scheduler setup
features.detail: schtasks registers FumiMaiaWeekly (Sat 10:00) and FumiQIDaily (Mon-Fri 09:00) at /RL HIGHEST. --remove / --list helpers. Script ready; tasks not registered. Note: task names lack the QI_ prefix the standards expect.

features.name: maia/ expression layer
features.detail: Pre-wired empty packages (each just an __init__.py + README). voice = migrate Fumi's writing half; memory = the diary (to build); speech/face/conversation/longform = empty rooms for the evolved Maia. No logic yet.

features.name: gate/ Governor
features.detail: Documented placeholder for the approval queue (draft -> the owner approves -> publish). To build in the first dev phase alongside the Fumi split. No code.

features.name: identity/ Kit
features.detail: Machine-readable identity manifest pointing to the soul (PERSONA_BIBLE.md) with face/voice_spoken/style all status='placeholder' (empty references, null seed/embedding). Created, not populated.

features.name: Live smoke test
features.detail: pytest module that hits the live API on :8500 for /health, /version, /info, and /openapi.json. Cleanly skips the whole module when the service is offline, so CI stays green without a running service.

features.name: Session summary tool
features.detail: Project tooling for generating session summary documents (QI documentation discipline).
